ns2:section.sectionText: Students with training or experience in audio journalism are invited to be part of the working Illinois Public Media newsroom on the U of I campus. Students will practice peer mentoring to produce work ranging from spot news to full feature stories for WILL-AM, WILL-FM and IllinoisNewsroom.org, with the chance to produce stories for a national audience. Students will choose to pursue 1-4 credit hours based on the rubric that a minimum of forty-five hours of production activity must be completed over the course of the semester for each credit hour. Pre-requisite: JOUR 335 or instructor approval. All students must reach out to Professor Evans at cre@illinois.edu for approval to take the course. This course will meet in room 109 of the Illinois Public Media building (Campbell Hall) at 300 N Goodwin Ave; Urbana. The instructor will provide more details on attendance.
